content: For a known RSS 2.0 feed in the browser, use DOMParser.parseFromString(xml, application/xml) per MDN. rss-parser 3.13.0 last published 2023-04-11 and depends on xml2js (Node). fast-xml-parser 5.11.0 is maintained but adds no value over DOMParser for one RSS 2.0 document. Check parsererror node on parse failure.
